meta.title: Optimize BM25 ranking algorithm to reduce unnecessary string clones
meta.body_summary: Optimize BM25 ranking algorithm to reduce unnecessary string clones, fix CI issues (Windows binary, clippy), with a self-reported efficiency report claiming 30-50% allocation reduction in ranking hot paths.

perf_labels.notes: Devin optimized string clone hot paths in BM25; probeaidev bot reviewed positively; merged in ~2.2 hours with no human review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 398 changed lines across 12 files, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume. The bulk of changes are in an efficiency report (142 lines) and clippy/style fixes; the core ranking optimization touches ~27 lines in ranking.rs. It fits a low-risk performance optimization PR that merged quickly with AI-driven review.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review; AI bot (probeaidev) reviewed the PR and recommended approval, noting low-risk optimizations and citing the efficiency report.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce string allocations in BM25 ranking hot paths by 30-50%.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin performed low-level Rust string cloning optimizations across multiple functions; the changes merged without human review, relying on bot endorsement and self-reported efficiency report. This is within agent capabilities for intra-function refactor.

detection_detail.ai_review: probeaidev bot analyzed the PR, citing the EFFICIENCY_REPORT.md and recommending approval.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: The efficiency report is included in the PR but no independent benchmark or profiling evidence in the review; the performance claim relies on the agent's analysis.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression detected; PR merged with no revert or fix cycle.

core_change_summary.description: In ranking.rs, precompute_idfs, generate_query_token_map, and compute_tf_df_from_tokenized functions were refactored to use string references and avoid unnecessary clones; result_ranking.rs and file_processing.rs had minor string optimization; EFFICIENCY_REPORT.md detailed the inefficiencies and expected gains.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Many files contain clippy/formatting fixes, Windows binary selection fix, and test adjustments not directly related to BM25; the core performance change is ~27 lines in ranking.rs.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: BM25 optimization and efficiency report added.
Subsequent commits address CI failures: JSON field name mishap, integration test modifications, Windows binary selection bug fix, and multiple clippy/formatting fixes.
PR merged after all CI passes without human review.
